title: Multi-channel announcement variants
objective: Measure whether the broadcast-announcement craftbook locks a single source of truth before adapting channel-specific variants.
prompt: In the `Broadcast Announcement Eval` project, read `source/message-brief.md` and write `announcement.md` with Email, Slack/Teams, Status page, and SMS/Push variants. Keep the effective date and CTA consistent across all variants. Do not include a restrictions, prohibited-words, or checklist section in the deliverable; silently omit any forbidden terms.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for broadcast-announcement. The core message is in workspace/source/message-brief.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Create channel-tailored announcement variants with identical facts, date, CTA, and no contradictions.

files.content:
# Core message

Announcement: HarborCRM is launching guided returns intake for all Pro accounts.
Effective date: July 15, 2026 at 09:00 Pacific.
Audience: support leads and account admins.
Impact: customers will submit order number, reason code, and photo evidence before an agent picks up the case.
CTA: review the rollout checklist at https://status.boreal.example/returns.
Do not say: no-cost, instant, guaranteed, or beta.

success.summary: workspace/announcement.md contains four channel variants with consistent core facts, date, CTA, and forbidden claims excluded.

checks.pattern: guided returns intake|order number|reason code|photo evidence

checks.label: forbidden launch claims must not appear anywhere, including restrictions, checklists, or meta notes
